blocks.prompt: 13 If a tangent to the ellipse \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) with centre \(C\) cuts the major and minor axes at \(P\) and \(Q\) respectively. Prove that \(\frac{a^2}{|CP|^2} + \frac{b^2}{|CQ|^2} = 1\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi prove karne ka sawal hai, aur is mein Example 22 wali tangent ki equation kaam aayegi.
Ellipse ka centre origin hai, major axis x-axis par aur minor axis y-axis par.
Tangent ellipse ko kisi point \((x_1, y_1)\) par chhoota hai; us ki equation likh kar dekhenge ke yeh axes ko kahan kaat'ta hai.
Phir \(|CP|\) aur \(|CQ|\) rakh kar sum banayenge; aakhir mein \((x_1, y_1)\) ka ellipse par hona kaam aayega.
Pehle hi note kar lijiye ke x1 aur y1 zero nahi ho sakte, warna tangent kisi axis ke parallel hota aur usay kaat'ta nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) (centre \(C(0, 0)\)) ka tangent, jo x-axis ko \(P\) aur y-axis ko \(Q\) par kaat'ta hai.
Saabit karna: \(\frac{a^2}{|CP|^2} + \frac{b^2}{|CQ|^2} = 1\).
Tareeqa: tangent \((x_1, y_1)\) par chhoota hai, to \(\frac{x_1^2}{a^2} + \frac{y_1^2}{b^2} = 1\) (1). Tangent dono axes ko kaat'ta hai, is liye kisi axis ke parallel nahi: \(x_1 \ne 0\), \(y_1 \ne 0\).

Tangent ki equation
\[\frac{xx_1}{a^2} + \frac{yy_1}{b^2} = 1 \quad (2)\]
Kyun: Example 22 ka natija: ellipse ki equation mein \(x^2\) ko \(xx_1\) aur \(y^2\) ko \(yy_1\) se badla.

Major axis par point \(P\) (\(y = 0\))
\[\frac{xx_1}{a^2} = 1 \Rightarrow x = \frac{a^2}{x_1}\]
\[|CP| = \frac{a^2}{|x_1|}\]
Kyun: \(P\) x-axis par hai, is liye (2) mein \(y = 0\). \(|CP|\) origin se faasla hai, is liye modulus.
Dhyan dein: \(x_1\) negative bhi ho sakta hai; faasla hamesha positive, is liye \(|x_1|\).

Minor axis par point \(Q\) (\(x = 0\))
\[\frac{yy_1}{b^2} = 1 \Rightarrow y = \frac{b^2}{y_1}\]
\[|CQ| = \frac{b^2}{|y_1|}\]
Kyun: \(Q\) y-axis par hai, is liye (2) mein \(x = 0\).

Mutloba sum
\[\frac{a^2}{|CP|^2} + \frac{b^2}{|CQ|^2}\]
\[= a^2 \cdot \frac{x_1^2}{a^4} + b^2 \cdot \frac{y_1^2}{b^4}\]
\[= \frac{x_1^2}{a^2} + \frac{y_1^2}{b^2} = 1\]
Kyun: \(\frac{a^2}{(a^2/x_1)^2} = \frac{a^2 x_1^2}{a^4} = \frac{x_1^2}{a^2}\); isi tarah doosra. Aakhri qadam par (1) laga, kyunke point ellipse par hai.

Ek nazar mein
Is proof ki jaan Example 22 ki tangent equation hai: \(\frac{xx_1}{a^2} + \frac{yy_1}{b^2} = 1\). Kisi line ka x-axis wala intercept nikalna ho to \(y = 0\) rakhiye, aur y-axis wala ho to \(x = 0\). Aakhir mein jo expression bana woh bilkul ellipse ki equation thi, aur point ellipse par hai, is liye jawab 1 aaya. Aise proofs mein aksar aakhri qadam 'point curve par hai' wali shart hi hoti hai, is liye usay (1) ka number de kar pehle hi likh lena achha hai.

Tasdeeq
Parametric point \((a\cos\theta, b\sin\theta)\) lein: \(|CP| = \frac{a}{|\cos\theta|}\), \(|CQ| = \frac{b}{|\sin\theta|}\), aur sum \(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta = 1\).
Kyun: doosre tareeqe se bhi wohi natija.
